Boeing’s subsidiary, Tapestry Solutions, develops information technology and business intelligence solutions for defense, commercial, and government sectors. The Associate Software Engineer will develop and maintain software for F-15 Mission Planning systems, contributing across the software development lifecycle through coding, debugging, integration, testing, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Computer Software
No H1B
Security Clearance Required
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Develop, document, maintain, and unit test software code utilizing programming languages such as C#, Javascript, and SQL
Design and implement software components, ensuring seamless integration into fully functional systems
Utilize appropriate processes and tools, tailoring them to project needs for optimal results
Troubleshoot and resolve software defects, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions
Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to propose and develop innovative solutions to technical challenges
Work under general supervision, demonstrating initiative and accountability in project execution
Compile and integrate software components into builds, conducting limited testing in target environments as needed
Participate in team meetings, code reviews, and documentation efforts to ensure quality and consistency
Perform additional duties as assigned to support project success and organizational goals
